hack.root_cause: Reentrancy via fake Pendle market → staking balance inflation → excess reward drain
hack.description: Penpie lost $27M when an attacker registered a fake Pendle market and exploited a reentrancy vulnerability in the harvest rewards function to inflate their staking balance and drain legitimate pool rewards.
